title: 26th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/26/2/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 19/2/2026 to 21/2/2026).

Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim asks Finance and Public Enterprises Minister Hassan Zareer why state-owned companies are dismissing MDP-affiliated staff against the law, given the Constitution bars political discrimination in appointments and dismissals.
Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim asks Minister Hassan Zareer how many state-owned companies have been dissolved under cost-cutting plans, and how many employees work at newly created companies.

Continued debate (unfinished business) on Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed's resolution urging the government to immediately halt the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" selling permanent residency to foreigners and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
General Affairs Committee report on Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdhooh's proposal to remove a clause of Rule 257-1 of Parliament's Rules of Procedure.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's request for Parliament's approval to join and ratify the Charter of the Multinational Maritime Defence Coalition.
Finance Committee report on the bill to amend the Foreign Currency Act (Law No. 32/2024).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: MPs questioned the finance minister about firings and new hires at state-owned companies, kept debating the Pearl Residence (residency-for-sale) resolution, and received reports including one on a maritime defence coalition.
